_about: Google Fonts families that draw Vietnamese (METADATA.pb has subsets: vietnamese), from google/fonts at the pinned commit. Data for the font check, the Brand Kit stop-and-ask and the one-time font install (packages/hf-edit/googleFontsVi.mjs). Built by tools/fonts/pin-google-fonts-vi.mjs. files: [file, style, weight from, weight to, bytes, git blob SHA-1]. A family over bigBytes is fetched through Google's CSS, not as pinned files. noVietnamese: the other families of the repo, so 'no Vietnamese' is known offline.
